assets.produced_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: one photorealistic fidget-spinner sprite for a mobile ASMR game. Create a realistic blush-pink classic THREE-ARM fidget spinner, photographed strictly straight down, face-on orthographic with zero perspective or tilt. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no surface, hand, text, logo, watermark or cast shadow. Precisely balanced threefold rotational symmetry: three identical rounded lobes evenly spaced exactly 120 degrees, one lobe straight up, two down-left and down-right. Each lobe has one identical concentric polished stainless-steel bearing, circular and perfectly face-on, with dark inset race. Soft pastel pink molded plastic body with convincing satin material, subtle fine texture, softly beveled edges and gentle realistic highlights. Round pink finger cap exactly at the true rotation center; cap center must be EXACTLY at the center of the square image. Make all three arms equal length and width. Symmetrical diffuse overhead studio lighting. Crisp object silhouette, sharp detail, no motion blur. Entire spinner fits within the central 82 percent of the square with generous transparent padding on every side. This is an actual photographed-looking physical toy, not a drawing, vector illustration, icon, or 3D cartoon. Deliver a single complete spinner, not a sprite sheet or multiple objects.
assets.description: ImageGen overhead pink fidget spinner. App.jsx masks the center out of the rotating image and displays the same photographed cap as a separate stationary circular layer.
